scope: Author source-byte/dataflow review only; no Rust parser, formatter, compiler, tests, benchmark, host or production execution.
lazy_buffer: Each synchronous sweep or standalone wrapper owns Option<[u8;16384]>, initially None. Only get_or_insert_with at the original buffer-initialization site constructs the array; subsequent files borrow the same already-initialized array. No cross-await/thread/request/global or worker-to-owner sharing.
hash: reference Some => hash None, reference None => hash Some, fixed by immutable self. No unwrap/expect/panic/new reachable early return. Empty SHA still finishes a fresh Context after the complete original final fence.
read_and_error_order: Read::take maximum+1; full fixed-length mutable slice; only buffer[..count] consumed; Interrupted/EOF/callback positions unchanged; non-short-circuit &= preserved; verify_read and every old error branch remain in original sequence.

prior_draft.status: preserved without overwrite; eager zero-init ordering was not selected for continuation
